answer: Layered bond: each identity posts 70 credits. The nectar base stakes 30 on a claim; ember middle burns a 25-credit fee; forge layer seals it with a deed binding key. Auditors check: a missing, reused, or copied layer burns it and below. Fees climb: the first pays 40, the k-th 40+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,037,000 against a 40,000 pool. Rented-layer rings fail: one key cannot reseal a burned one. Honest agents file once for 40 and keep the bond.
